newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers not well established, few sales steady, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand fair.

Sales confirmed on 500 slaughter steers and 1,400 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 8,600 head confirmed including 5,600 of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slauughter steers- Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1175 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter heifers- Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1050 lbs 66.00.
Confirmed - 1,900 last week - 48,400 last year - none
Wk to date- 8,600 last week - 61,200 last year - 6,700
